customManagers.description: The devenv CLI that setup-devenv installs from a commit, with its release tag in the step name
matchStrings: name: Install devenv (?<currentValue>v\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\n\s+shell: bash\n\s+run: nix profile add github:cachix/devenv/(?<currentDigest>[a-f0-9]{40})#devenv

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: pnpm refuses versions younger than its minimumReleaseAge (pnpm-workspace.yaml), so Renovate waits as long before proposing one
One weekly PR for every minor and patch npm update instead of one per package
oxlint and @oxlint/plugins must stay on the same exact version, so they move together even across a major

@playwright/test must stay on the version of nixpkgs' playwright-driver, whose browsers devenv.nix puts on PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH; a newer npm version looks for browser builds that path does not hold, so it moves by hand with the devenv.lock update that moves playwright-driver
